verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair openness question for payroll software, since on-premises payroll products exist, so the axis applies. The evidence describes only an Intuit-hosted cloud service with Intuit-run tax filing and expert setup. Developer APIs, sandbox companies, the Web Connector and the Desktop SDK are integration building blocks, not a way to deploy the core product on your own infrastructure.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
